tagline.en: ZeroScope — a lightweight, community-favorite text-to-video model with a base 576w and an XL upscale variant.
tagline.zh: ZeroScope——轻量、广受社区喜爱的文生视频模型，含基础 576w 与 XL 高清变体。

en: ZeroScope is a well-known open text-to-video model from the cerspense project, built on a classic U-Net diffusion architecture. It turns a text prompt into a short video clip and has long been a popular, easy-to-run choice in the open community.

It comes in two checkpoints: zeroscope_v2_576w as the base generator, and zeroscope_v2_XL for upscaling to higher resolution. In WorldFoundry it runs through a Diffusers-based route, matching the standard ZeroScope pipeline.
Both checkpoints are released under CC-BY-NC-4.0, which limits use to non-commercial purposes.
zh: ZeroScope 是 cerspense 项目发布的知名开源文生视频模型，采用经典的 U-Net 扩散架构。它把一段文字提示词生成为短视频，长期以来是开源社区中易于上手、广受欢迎的选择。
它提供两个 checkpoint：作为基础生成器的 zeroscope_v2_576w，以及用于放大到更高分辨率的 zeroscope_v2_XL。在 WorldFoundry 中，它通过基于 Diffusers 的路线运行，与标准 ZeroScope pipeline 一致。
两个 checkpoint 均采用 CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可，仅限非商业用途。

whenToUse.en: A good pick for quick, lightweight text-to-video prototyping in the open ecosystem — use the 576w base to generate and the XL checkpoint to upscale, within a non-commercial license.
whenToUse.zh: 在开源生态中做快速、轻量的文生视频原型时是不错的选择——用 576w 基础模型生成、再用 XL checkpoint 放大，需遵守非商业许可。

notFor.en: The CC-BY-NC-4.0 license rules out commercial use. It is a legacy U-Net diffusion model, so quality trails newer transformer-based video models.
notFor.zh: CC-BY-NC-4.0 许可排除商业用途。它是较早的 U-Net 扩散模型，画质不及更新的基于 Transformer 的视频模型。

en: Two checkpoints: 576w base and XL for upscaling
Runs through a standard Diffusers pipeline
zh: 广受欢迎的轻量开源文生视频模型
两个 checkpoint：576w 基础与用于放大的 XL
通过标准 Diffusers pipeline 运行
